study_identification_part.si_4_title: Charting brain growth and aging at high spatial precision

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Datasets identified from the study text and supplementary files, mapped to the provided Minor Category list. 'MULTI-SITE (N>=2)' covers other sites like SRPBS, Delta, KCL, etc., which are not in the list.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Data from 82 sites were combined... including ABCD, ABIDE, ADHD200, CAMCAN, CMI-HBN, HCP-Aging, HCP-Development, HCP-Early Psychosis, HCP-Young Adult, IXI, NKI-RS, Oasis, OpenNeuro, PNC, SRPBS, and UKBiobank... Studies (sites) contributing clinical data included: Autism Brain Imaging Database Exchange... ADHD200... CNP, SRPBS... Delta... HCP Early Psychosis... KCL... UMich... TOP...
